caveats: Top-1-percent image score is an uncalibrated map aggregation shared by both models. The original learned global score is a separate pipeline.
At threshold zero all scores are positive. Its image F1 is a prevalence-dependent baseline, not evidence of useful specificity.
Korus primary counts white and gray mask regions positive; Columbia provenance masks are excluded from pooled binary localization.
Nine tampered masks have incompatible dimensions; their images remain in classification but are excluded from localization.
All-dataset scores are descriptive and dataset/prevalence weighted. IMD2020 overlaps original training; 256 images were examined during Mini development.

Timing measures the two sequential model forward passes during concurrent execution; original always precedes Mini. It is not a separately measured Mini-only wall-clock batch duration or universal hardware speedup.
The ratio of summed forward seconds is workload weighted and differs from the mean or median image-wise speed ratio.
Bootstrap intervals describe resampling of this collection, not independent replication, cross-dataset generalization or proof of equivalence.
Timing bootstrap intervals reflect the mix of source images, not uncertainty estimated from repeated complete timing runs.
The current proxy named TruFor Mini here is the flow-inactive frozen checkpoint, not the earlier Mini V1 or neuron333 output.
